sampling_unit: every detected source core at every declared snapshot; times and conditions nested in deterministic worlds

measure.Q: complete single-core source components confirming any stable identity after delay-zero isolation, counted once per source core
measure.C: all detected cores including shared, ineligible, unknown, capped and nonconfirming sources
measure.R: C-Q; unresolved potential recovery, never measured nonviability
measure.range: [Q,C] over detected source bodies potentially recoverable under declared isolation; never bounds total viable population
measure.registry_score: retain protocol009 fixed-registry counts separately at 81 times
measure.identity: measure source identity as observed; descendant identity never retroassigned
measure.empty_snapshot: Q=R=C=0; resolution fraction missing, never one
measure.ancestry: ambiguous native ancestry; serial isolation is an intervention

extraction.complete_component: retain all arms; reject multicore, disconnected residual and noncontractible components; validated periodic unwrapping only

controls.known_omitted_inputs: three distinct complete delay-zero unknown inputs confirmed by protocol010, repeated implementation controls, not independent calibration samples

gates.failure: retain diagnostics and freeze subsequent design with calibration qualification; no joint ecological confirmation
gates.prior_gate: protocol010 failure unchanged; new scored recovery describes new contexts, resolved share is precision not biological sensitivity

cache: key includes complete component physical hash, measured input identity, rule hash, isolation configuration and original/any endpoint; every distinct eligible key consumes local128 admission even when globally cached; chronological time then lexicographic core; duplicates retain observation multiplicity

execution.schedule: acquisition, independent audits, rendering and Git packing sequentially
execution.resume: hash-verified complete unit receipts only; retain interrupted logs
